answer.origin: NVIDIA Corporation blog post (publisher and original speaker NVIDIA Corporation, party statement), stated date 2026-07-01; Sharon AI CEO James Manning and Firmus Technologies co-CEO Tim Rosenfield are quoted within it.
answer.note: Source claim: NVIDIA said on 2026-07-01 that a new business model lets AI clouds procure NVIDIA infrastructure for AI-native, enterprise and ISV customers through a revenue-sharing and credit-support model. Under this model NVIDIA would earn standard product revenue plus a share of cloud revenue on the supported capacity, which NVIDIA describes as a recurring, usage-linked earnings stream. What it supports about NVDA: the company is describing a financing-linked channel for selling its infrastructure into AI cloud operators, with economics tied to downstream cloud usage, and it names Sharon AI, Firmus, and AI natives Baseten, Fireworks AI and Together AI as context. Firmus's Batam, Indonesia DSX AI factory campus is described as expected to scale to 360 megawatts and up to 170,000 NVIDIA GPUs; this is a forward expectation in a party statement, not a confirmed build-out or delivered order. Conditional interpretation: if the model is applied at scale, NVDA's revenue mix could shift toward product sales plus a usage-linked component, and NVDA's own credit support could add balance-sheet exposure to AI cloud counterparties; the magnitude of either effect is not disclosed in the source.
limitations: The source gives no revenue-share percentage, credit-support amount, contract duration or accounting treatment, so the size of NVDA's share of cloud revenue and of its credit exposure cannot be estimated from it.
No signing status is disclosed for the Sharon AI or Firmus arrangements with NVIDIA; the source does not establish that either has been executed.
The 360 MW and 170,000 GPU figures for the Firmus Batam campus are expectations with no stated timing, financing or NVIDIA share of the purchase, so they do not establish NVDA order volume.
Sharon AI's quote gives no quantities, dates or contract terms, so it supports only that a collaboration was announced.
NVIDIA is the publisher and original speaker, so the source is a self-description of its own model and is not independently confirmed.
follow_up: Check NVIDIA's next annual or quarterly filing for disclosure of the revenue-sharing or credit-support arrangements, including any receivable, guarantee or deferred revenue lines tied to AI cloud counterparties.
Check Firmus and Sharon AI announcements or regulatory filings for signing status, financing sources and timing of the NVIDIA-linked capacity.
Check subsequent Firmus Batam campus progress reporting for megawatts energized and GPU deployments against the stated expectations of 360 MW and 170,000 GPUs.
